stage: Completed source and versioned-build verification before publication
scope: Practical breadboard assembly with rigid THT parts, fixed-body formed leads, explicit seating, accessible socket feedback, touch editing and jumper wiring.

newNativeValidation.scope: Native parsing of new reference component; existing2002nativeoutputs are unchanged. Does not establish manufacturing accuracy.

checks: Breadboard parts filter and ordinary library clicks place resistor, LED, NE555 and four-leg tactile switch onto free holes without decorative overlap.
Hover highlights all five actual strip holes, press highlights its full net, and Escape clears the temporary feedback.
Select-dragging one blue lead tip reshapes only that leg, keeps its body and other leg fixed, and reseats electrically without creating a wire.
Lifting a single leg opens only that connection; one Undo restores its exact formed tip and electrical pairing.
Visible Move body, keep leads control moves the resistor body while both inserted tips and nets stay fixed.
A real jumper between spare breadboard holes joins the resistor and LED through their conductors and explicit inserted leads.
Every formed metal tip in the actual rendered art matches its electrical endpoint and breadboard hole.
The usable breadboard circuit exports as SVG/PNG and round-trips all formed geometry and connections.
390px library filter and native taps insert a resistor on the sole breadboard with both leads connected.
An exact breadboard hole responds directly to touch rather than opening a 420-contact picker.
Native touch dragging the blue tip moves only one formed lead and reseats it without moving the resistor body.
A second touch cancels the lead preview and leaves the saved circuit unchanged.

findingsFixed: New lead placement could target an otherwise free hole hidden beneath a seated PCB; insertion availability now reserves those covered holes.

Repeated host-hole assembly during relational validation and quick-placement probing caused multi-second stalls; resolved-host immutable hole/index caches and shared search targets eliminate that repeated work.
independentReview.regression: test/breadboard-clearance.test.mjs covers exact Pico/F12 case at every quarter-turn, retained other lead, unchanged bodies and accessible socket reseating.

performanceFixture.scope: One local Node run of a valid dense 100-row, 10+10-cell breadboard with 264 nonoverlapping LEDs. Timings are local evidence, not a universal performance guarantee.

whitespace: git diff --check and changed/new text whitespace scan passed
artifactScope: Temporary browser screenshots/build paths identify locally reviewed QA artifacts and are not shipped application files.
